subject.title: fix(feishu): preserve text when replies include media

question: Should this PR wait for a successful current-head Feishu run showing both final text and a valid regular attachment, or may a Feishu owner supply equivalent proof and explicitly accept the contributor proof gap?
rationale: The patch has no identified blocking defect, but external-contributor real-behavior proof is a merge gate and the submitted run failed the media half of the claimed behavior.

options.title: Require successful combined proof
options.body: Approve only after redacted client and gateway evidence shows both final text and a valid attachment delivered from the current head.

options.title: Accept owner-run validation
options.body: A Feishu owner provides equivalent successful live validation and explicitly owns the contributor proof exception.

recommendation.title: Require successful combined proof
recommendation.body: Approve only after redacted client and gateway evidence shows both final text and a valid attachment delivered from the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review identifies this handle as the Feishu package owner best positioned to judge actual channel behavior and proof sufficiency.
